ratings.comment: He was my favorite professor at Madison! So so funny and entertaining with interesting content! Would so take him again.

Professor Oguinn was the most down-to-earth man. The content was very interesting and I absolutely loved his class! Only had 4 papers and 2 exams the whole year, super easy, take any of his classes while you still can!

One of the best professors. No final, does not care about grades that much, and lectures are interesting. Besides the 4, 2-page essays you need to write throughout the semester, this class is super easy. posts lecture slides on canvas, 2 online exams in the whole semester, and honestly you don't have to do the assigned readings. take his class!

Tom is a very amazing and smart guy. This class is very inspirational and it makes you shift your perspective about marketing. I love his approach of explaining the psychology of why marketing campaigns are successful.

Best professor I've had in UW-Madison! Professor O'Guinn is a really smart guy and I learn something applicable every time in his lectures. His lectures are interesting and he's very humble and hilarious.

Tom is legit the best professor I've ever had at UW-Madison. It's clear that his goal for the class is to actually prepare students for the real world. He has incredible stories about various brands he's worked for and is hilarious too. Technology isn't his strong suit but he is willing to do anything for his students. 100/10

What a guy. Tom is a great professor because he's worked on so many unique branding/consulting jobs over his professional career so his lectures are packed full of real world experience and knowledge. Super laid back guy who just wants to share what he's learned and not stress out students. Too bad he is likely retiring soon.

Tom was an amazing professor and if given the chance, take a class with him. Aside from his class being easy, his lectures are awesome, thought-provoking and inspirational. He cares more about students learning than any professor I've ever had. His lectures were relevant and current. He doesn't care about grades but instead that we listen and learn

This class was great! Your grade is only made up of 3 tests which are very very do-able and the material is very interesting and fun. Tom was one of my favorite professors and you can tell he cares a lot about his students. I would highly recommend taking this class (or any class with him) if you are unsure! I took it as a senior & it was the best

My favorite class in my entire college life! Interesting content and you can really learn many things that you were never aware of before. He is really passionate about brand management and the exams are fair.

Awesome professor, very engaging. I fell in love with this topic because of how passionate he is about it. He will assign what seems like tons of reading but a lot of the articles are short and easy to read anyway. Someone needs to teach him how to operate a Microsoft - but other than that he was a great, laid back, dude.

Very entertaining. Class as a whole has a ton of reading, but the professor goes over the readings in class every time so you don't really have to do him. He was a hippie growing up so he has some cool stories.

I love Brand Mgmt & Strategy!  He is very funny and I felt I learned a lot.  The slides aren't too helpful and he jumps around a lot..make sure to read the articles for exam.  Case studies are rather easy if you put in honest effort.   I really enjoyed his class.

Very knowledgable man, we have learned about his work in other classes. Grade is based on 2 exams (25% each), two 1pg papers, one 3-5pg paper, and class participation. No idea how he keeps track of participation since he rarely asks for your name. Slides aren't very clear - must read the articles and go to class so you understand stuff.

Thomas' brand management class was very relevant and interesting.  This may be a positive or negative depending who you are, but he cancels class alot which I found to be very frustrating because my tuition dollars are paying for all of the classes whether he taught them or not.  He also ends lecture very early and runs out of material to teach. :(

O'Guinn is the man! Great Professor for Brand Management, he's an expert in the field. When I took it, class required only 5 typed 1-page case studies for 50% of the grade;the rest was class participation. Lots of real world experience.Don't worry about his aloof style, he likes students and is generally an easy grader.Take this class with O'Guinn.
Great brand managment class...Easy exams and one final paper and he loves to give good grades.  Take his classes if possible
